# Luxus Collection

> Premium curated firearms dealer specializing in collectible and modern firearms. Licensed FFL dealer located in the United States. Inventory includes rare collectibles, modern sporting rifles, handguns, and accessories.

## Shop

- [All Products](https://luxus-collection.com/shop): Full product catalog
- [Modern Firearms](https://luxus-collection.com/shop/modern-firearms): Current-production firearms
- [Collectible Firearms](https://luxus-collection.com/shop/collectible-firearms): Vintage and rare collectibles
- [Shop by Brand](https://luxus-collection.com/shop/brands): Browse by manufacturer
- [Shop by Model](https://luxus-collection.com/shop/models): Browse by model

## Product Pages

Individual product pages are at `https://luxus-collection.com/product/[handle]`. Each page includes full specifications, condition, caliber, action type, price, and availability.

## MCP Server (for AI Agents)

A Model Context Protocol server is available for programmatic access to the public product catalog. It provides structured, filterable access to inventory, brands, categories, and site information.

- Endpoint: `https://api.luxus-collection.com/mcp/mcp`
- Transport: Streamable HTTP (POST)
- Protocol: MCP 1.0 (JSON-RPC 2.0)

### Available Tools

- `search_products` — keyword search across public inventory
- `get_product` — full product detail by URL handle
- `check_availability` — real-time stock status
- `list_brands` — all carried brands
- `get_brand_products` — products filtered by brand
- `list_categories` — product categories
- `list_articles` — guides and articles
- `get_site_info` — business contact, hours, and address

Note: Backroom and private-room inventory is not accessible via the MCP server.
